agents_md_rule: AGENTS.md is the repository boot gate for coding agents that honor repository instruction files; it does not grant permissions; the host agent still needs authorized access.
commit_semantics: A commit proves a change was recorded; it does not prove the intended behavior.
github_role: A durable engineering and institutional-memory surface for code, contracts, evidence references and handoffs.
pr_rule: PRs should expose scope, evidence, limitations and acceptance status.
pre_change_rule: Know the current branch, base, head and merge path before changing files.
purpose: The git operations doctrine of the activation kit: GitHub's role, what AGENTS.md does and does not do, what a commit proves, and PR expectations.
title: OPERATIONS / GIT
